lines.en: I cross the meadow with light hooves.

lines.zh: 角上滴下一点彩虹，落到草里。
lines.en: A little rainbow drips from my horn into the grass.

lines.zh: 我沿着光走，脚下是天堂的草。
lines.en: I walk by the light over Heaven's grass.

lines.zh: 步子慢一点，草才长得回来。
lines.en: Slow steps, so the grass can grow back.

lines.zh: 我身后留下一道淡淡的彩带。
lines.en: A faint ribbon of color trails behind me.

lines.zh: 同伴在坡上，我过去挨着它。
lines.en: My herd is on the slope; I go stand by them.
Clouds below, and I walk above them.
The grass on this path is the softest.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛被风吹成一片彩。
lines.en: The wind combs my mane into a sheet of color.
I step around that glowing flower.

lines.zh: 一起走的时候，颜色会混起来。
lines.en: Walking together, our colors blend.

lines.zh: 我停下来等落在后面的同伴。
lines.en: I stop to wait for the herd behind me.
Rainwater has pooled in my hoofprints.
The slope is gentle; I climb it slowly.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片荧光苔，光沾在蹄上。
lines.en: I cross glowing moss and light clings to my hooves.

lines.zh: 我绕着水潭走，怕踩脏了水。
lines.en: I walk around the pool so as not to muddy it.

lines.zh: 我站着，光从角上滑下来。
lines.en: I stand still as light slides off my horn.
The wind of Heaven tastes sweet.
I lower my head for a bite of young grass.

lines.zh: 二十五点生命，够我慢慢活。
lines.en: Twenty-five hit points are enough to live slowly.

lines.zh: 我身上的彩纹在太阳下变淡。
lines.en: My colors fade under the sun.

lines.zh: 有只小东西在我脚边转。
lines.en: A small creature circles my feet.

lines.zh: 我不着急，这里没有夜晚。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; there is no night here.

lines.zh: 我把角抵在树干上蹭痒。
lines.en: I rub my horn against a trunk to scratch.

lines.zh: 同伴在打盹，我替它看着。
lines.en: My herd dozes, and I keep watch for them.

lines.zh: 我甩甩尾巴，赶走几只虫。
lines.en: I flick my tail to shoo a few insects.

lines.zh: 草地这么亮，我眼睛有点酸。
lines.en: The meadow is so bright my eyes ache a little.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，是雨要来了吗？
lines.en: I sniff — is rain coming?
Even my shadow has colors.
The light at my horn tip turns slowly.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕到身前，盖住蹄子。
lines.en: I curl my tail forward over my hooves.

lines.zh: 我抬头看那些浮在空中的岛。
lines.en: I look up at the islands floating in the air.

lines.zh: 你身上没有光，可你站得很稳。
lines.en: You carry no light, yet you stand steady.

lines.zh: 你是从下面来的客人吗？
lines.en: Are you a guest from below?

lines.zh: 我低下角，让你看清颜色。
lines.en: I lower my horn so you can see its colors.

lines.zh: 你的手很粗糙，像走过远路。
lines.en: Your hands are rough, like someone who walked far.

lines.zh: 我靠近你，闻闻你的袖子。
lines.en: I come close and sniff your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你不像猎人，猎人走得更快。
lines.en: You are no hunter; hunters walk faster.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的角，别眨眼。
lines.en: You look up at my horn — do not blink.
Do you want to touch it? Gently.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在草地上，变暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the grass and darkens it.
There are iron studs in the sound of your boots.
Heaven seldom has visitors.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我把角给你看。
lines.en: Stand still and I will show you my horn.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，往旁边跳开。
lines.en: I took a hit and sprang aside.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛被扯乱，很难看。
lines.en: My mane is torn and looks awful.
It hurts; I retreat among the herd.
My flank is bleeding.
Who struck me? It was so quiet here.
Head down, my horn still guarding.
The colors on my horn shuddered once.
I cannot run fast; my hooves feel weak.

lines.zh: 同伴围过来，我不那么怕了。
lines.en: The herd gathers, and I fear less.
I am all right; I just need a moment.

lines.zh: 你手里那把草，我看见了。
lines.en: I have seen the grass in your hand.

lines.zh: 我走过来，只是想吃一口。
lines.en: I am coming over only for a bite.
This grass is sweeter than what grows here.
Bring the grass up to my muzzle.
I will leave once I finish; I will not cling.
The smell you brought is unfamiliar.
I followed you for a short way.

lines.zh: 再抓一把，我陪你走到坡上。
lines.en: One more handful, and I will walk with you uphill.
My herd wants a share too.

lines.zh: 放地上吧，我不抢你的手。
lines.en: Set it on the ground; I will not nip your hand.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起小时候。
lines.en: This taste reminds me of being young.
You shake your hand and a blade falls.

lines.zh: 我舔舔你的掌心，算谢了。
lines.en: I lick your palm as thanks.
Not too much, or I will not want to walk.

lines.zh: 你把草举过肩，我踮了一下脚。
lines.en: You raise the grass; I come up on my toes.
I have eaten this grass before; it is sweet.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的肩，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and I swayed a little.
My horn tip grazed the edge of your cloak.

lines.zh: 别用肩膀推，我蹄子打滑。
lines.en: Do not shove with your shoulder; my hooves slip.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的鬃毛弄乱了。
lines.en: That messed up my mane.

lines.zh: 我退一步，蹄子踩进泥里。
lines.en: I step back and my hoof sinks in mud.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，颜色都花了。
lines.en: We collided and our colors smeared.
You are harder than you look.

lines.zh: 我贴着你站好，不生气了。
lines.en: I settle beside you, no longer cross.

lines.zh: 草地被我们踩出一个圆圈。
lines.en: Our hooves left a bare circle in the grass.
Easy — I am still carrying light.
It touches its horn to mine.

lines.zh: 我们的颜色绕成一条带子。
lines.en: Our colors wind into a single band.
The grass is soft; we walk slowly.

lines.zh: 它比我高半头，鬃毛更亮。
lines.en: It stands half a head taller, mane brighter.
We went up the slope, one after the other.
The light falls on its back beautifully.
Soon there will be little ones walking with us.
It licked my neck.
This meadow has enough grass for both of us.

lines.zh: 我们没有走远，就在附近。
lines.en: We did not go far — only nearby.

lines.zh: 我叼起一朵掉下来的花。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen flower.

lines.zh: 角上挂着的东西，我甩不掉。
lines.en: The thing caught on my horn will not shake loose.
This thing is bright; I will keep it.
If you do not need it, I will take it.

lines.zh: 我把它放在我们常去的石头边。
lines.en: I leave it by the stone we always visit.
Too heavy for my teeth, so I let it drop.

lines.zh: 我用嘴拱了拱，它滚开了。
lines.en: I nosed it and it rolled away.
This is not grass; I will not eat it.
I balance it on the tip of my horn.
You dropped this; I will bring it back.
The grass is moving over there; I look.
Something is approaching my herd.
I put the little ones behind me.

lines.zh: 我不爱打架，可我会站住。
lines.en: I dislike fighting, but I will stand my ground.
That shadow does not belong in Heaven.
I lower my head and aim my horn.

lines.zh: 它再近一步，我就不退了。
lines.en: One more step from it and I stop backing away.
I call out first to warn the herd.
This pasture belongs to our herd.
It walked away, and I am still watching.
I watch it and paw the ground.

lines.zh: 它的味道很冲，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Its smell is sharp and I dislike it.
I swing my flank across the narrow path.
It walks a circle; my hooves follow.
The colors on my horn have drawn in.
The herd has fallen back behind me.
Its breath rattles faintly between the trees.

lines.zh: 它越过那道草线，我就冲。
lines.en: One step past that grass line and I charge.
I number each step it takes toward us.
I hold my breath and let it move first.
I lower my head and thrust with my horn.
This one is to protect the herd.
I kicked once and hit it squarely.

lines.zh: 角上的光划出一道彩线。
lines.en: The light on my horn drew a line of color.
I pushed it back half a step.
I will not chase; its retreat is enough.
It clawed my flank.

lines.zh: 我甩头，鬃毛扫过它的脸。
lines.en: I tossed my head and my mane swept its face.
Done fighting, I go check the little ones.
I am breathing hard and stand unsteadily.

lines.zh: 我在天堂的草地上睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes on Heaven's grass.
My horn still carries the light of birth.
It is so bright here; I squint.

lines.zh: 一群同伴在不远处吃草。
lines.en: A herd grazes not far away.

lines.zh: 我试着站起来，腿有点软。
lines.en: I try to stand; my legs are unsteady.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的鬃毛全竖起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts my mane all at once.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见彩色的天。
lines.en: I see the colored sky for the first time.
The grass is sweet; I take a bite.
No one watched me come into being.

lines.zh: 我在原地转了一圈，认路。
lines.en: I turn once on the spot to learn the place.

lines.zh: 火烧到鬃毛，彩色的烟升起来。
lines.en: Fire caught my mane and colored smoke rose.

lines.zh: 我从云边掉下去，风在耳边响。
lines.en: I fell off the cloud's edge, wind roaring past.

lines.zh: 水淹到脖子，角上的光灭了。
lines.en: Water reached my neck and my horn's light died.
A blast threw the grass into the sky.
An arrow buried itself deep in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾让我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Violet mist keeps my eyes shut.
The grass has withered; I have not eaten all day.

lines.zh: 雷劈在草地，我四蹄发麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the meadow and numbed my hooves.

lines.zh: 天堂下面空了，我踩不到东西。
lines.en: Heaven's floor is gone; my hooves find nothing.
